notes.title: Notice of Issue Fix for VARLET - Digital Creative Artbook
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885970/VARLET__Digital_Creative_Artbook/"][/dynamiclink]We identified an issue where the “VARLET - Digital Creative Artbook” was not being correctly installed in the local files due to a distribution setting error.[/p][p]This issue has now been fixed and the distribution settings have been corrected.[/p][p][/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your continued support of “VARLET.”[/p][p][/p][p]For instructions on how to view the artbook, please refer to the Steam support information below:[/p][p][url="https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/720F-F7D3-0EB2-059F"]https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/720F-F7D3-0EB2-059F[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "VARLET" Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Not someone else—this is the story of finding yourself.
"VARLET" is now available![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406620/VARLET/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]To commemorate the release of "VARLET," we are also unveiling a special illustration by RIRI Yamashita, who created the game’s opening animation![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/addab5071b7021a00c0cd83a46d2eee153b91d38.png"][/img][b]illustration by 山下RIRI（@RIRI45309899）[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Furthermore, a [b]limited-time launch sale[/b] is being held to celebrate the release of "VARLET"!
The Digital Deluxe Edition, which allows you to experience the world of "VARLET" in even greater depth, is also available at a discount alongside the main game. Don’t miss this opportunity!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/b2cadc4fb474b1645330e340da760764955d2588.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Digital Deluxe Edition (Bundle) here][/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57020/VARLET_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][b]\[Contents][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/8e5b8fe91cee2d06b1da9e3c512dfd786472273e.png"][/img] The "VARLET" Digital Deluxe Edition is a set that includes the full game (download version) along with the following content:[/p][p]■ VARLET - (Digital Version)[/p][p]■ Digital Creative Artbook (80 pages)*[/p][p]■ Digital Special Album (53 tracks)[/p][p]■ Monark & The Caligula Effect 2 School Uniform Set DLC[/p][p]Be sure to grab the Digital Deluxe Edition and enjoy the world of "VARLET" even more![/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Self discovery begins with you. notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes: [p]／[/p][p]"VARLET"[/p][p]Only 1⃣ day left until release!![/p][p]＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/9f8c38d85b708744cecf569fee12417719dd07f8.jpg"][/img]illustration by chooco（@chocoshi3）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming release, we received a special comment from Gakuto Mikumo, who was in charge of the main scenario for the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/3a1a58c78e84afc42afe0736a4429115c0220ca9.png"][/img][/p][p]Full message below:[/p][p]From the moment I heard that the theme of this work would be “the desire for approval,” I’ve been thinking about what “desires” mean to the protagonist and the six companions—what their true “wishes” and “salvation” might be.[/p][p] [/p][p]When those runaway desires bare their fangs at the people around them and even at themselves, what will the protagonists choose to abandon, and what will they decide to embrace?[/p][p]I hope you will witness their “choices” and the “outcomes” that follow.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Scenario[/b][/p][p][b]Gakuto Mikumo[/b][/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes:
[p]／[/p][p]"VARLET"[/p][p]Only 2⃣ days left until release!![/p][p]＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/e809d93242d157a01d8456b3cc40bc5044d7b051.png"][/img]illustration by 水豹（@azarasi_haru）[/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming release, we received a special comment from Kazunari Suzuki, who was in charge of Scenario Editing for the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/d21c5bee30ea554bdfa2e73749efd81638956cc8.png"][/img]Full message below:
Following my work on [i]Monark[/i], which serves as the base of this title, I again took on Scenario Editing for VARLET. However, the main scenario is by none other than Gakuto Mikumo.[/p][p]Once he got a feel for incorporating it into the game, I entrusted it to him completely.[/p][p]As for the mob scenarios, I continued to work together with Ryutaro Ito, and I believe this time we’ve been able to deliver an even more polished work.[/p][p][/p][p]Scenario Editing / Digital Devil
[b]Kazunari Suzuki[/b][/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes:
[p]／[/p][p]“VARLET”[/p][p]Only 3⃣ days left until release!![/p][p]＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/749fde01c0f5868597cf60230c870ebc46f99124.jpg"][/img]illustration by うさまー（@U_summer07192）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from ITO Ryutaro, who handled the messages from the students and the sub-story scenario for this game’s school setting![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/e6a185d50145b0861eacc8f77d2cdfc9a01fcffb.png"][/img]Full message below:[/p][p]Following “Monark,” I was responsible for the student messages and sub-stories.[/p][p]I wanted to depict the small, everyday scenes that still exist within the school, even amid chaos.[/p][p]Within the grand narrative of “VARLET,” there are small yet meaningful stories that matter deeply to each student![/p][p]Without overthinking it, I hope you'll enjoy the occasional foolish but heartwarming—and presumably earnest—words and actions of the students, as you immerse yourself in the world of “VARLET.”[/p][p] [/p][p]Scenario
[b]ITO Ryutaro[/b][/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

[p]／
“VARLET”
Only 4⃣ days left until release!!
＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/2e56d07fac243337d78d1311e8124057cf73bdd0.png"][/img]illustration by SKYん（@Skyn_blue）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from [b]亥と卯[/b], who worked on the 3D models for the game’s main characters![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/51d6e085aa1fc6d4510ff04b7eeb2d50ba9efd8b.png"][/img][b]Full message below:

Character modeler [b]Hiro (@h1i9r8o1)[/b] also joined the project, and together we worked on how to faithfully translate the wonderful character designs into 3D models while keeping them as appealing as possible.[/p][p]I made sure they would look both cute and cool from every angle. I hope you’ll fully enjoy their charm not only in battles, but also through their interactions, evolving relationships, and school life![/p][p][b]亥と卯[/b][/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes: [p]／[/p][p]"VARLET"[/p][p]Only 5⃣ days left until release!![/p][p]＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/7a5d5f9520ac3f75da937b1b18413a3514879f23.png"][/img]illustration by ふぁっ熊 （@fakkuma）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming release, we also received a special comment from Tsukasa Masuko, who composed the BGM for the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/6eabf40a17ed145b950b5256b5d860233c680848.png"][/img]Full message below:[/p][p]I composed nearly 40 tracks for VARLET, including different arrangements.[/p][p][/p][p]During production, the word “VaperWave” even came up, but in the end, the music stayed true to my own style, fitting comfortably into what could be called my signature sound.[/p][p][/p][p]My ideal is for the music to blend seamlessly into the game—something you might not consciously recall, but suddenly remember when triggered by a moment. If you find yourself saying, “This track feels like Masuko,” and just let it wash over you, I’d be more than happy.[/p][p][/p][p]BGM Composer[/p][p]Tsukasa Masuko[/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes:
[p]／
“VARLET”
Only 6⃣ days left until release!!
＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/593e2bc6155234ec392df4a39c64b9318957cf0b.jpg"][/img]illustration by 黒須（@kurosususu）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from [b]wotaku[/b], the composer of the opening theme [i]“Shiori”[/i] and the another character song [i]“Dominant”[/i]![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/eceea9123401bba384d81ef466538f663c2e65fd.png"][/img][b]Full message below:[/b] [i]“Shiori”[/i] was created with duality in mind. Aiming for the light, yet trapped in the darkness.[/p][p][/p][p]When you lose sight of yourself, you turn back the pages of the past and remember what is truly important—that’s the image behind the title.[/p][p][/p][p]For [i]“Dominant”[/i], I wanted to express solitude, so I chose to distance it from today’s popular music.
Aiming for something hard to grasp, I incorporated complex, opera-style melodies.[/p][p][/p][p]It is a majestic and powerful song, but I would be glad if you can also feel the hidden loneliness and emptiness within it.[/p][p]
Composer of “Shiori” and “Dominant”
[b]wotaku[/b][/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Self discovery begins with you.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]“VARLET”
These students struggle to find their own answer while coping with the difficulties of growing up.
As you get to know them, you'll come to know more about yourself in this school life RPG.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p]

notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes: [p]／[/p][p]“VARLET”[/p][p]Only 7⃣ days left until release!![/p][p]＼[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/4b56cf120fc322d48bf75d6ca75d875533e2a2ff.png"][/img][/p][p]Illustration by フ子（@fucodoku）[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from NILFRUITS, the composer of the game’s ending theme![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/01616de999296ae9f80e7a8569a1bb0a937d945a.png"][/img]Full message below:[/p][p]I wrote an original song titled “Camelot” as the ending theme.[/p][p]The title comes from the city built by King Arthur together with the Knights of the Round Table.[/p][p]From that image, I envisioned the place where the protagonist and their companions march into battle and return to once more.[/p][p]I hope this song evokes a peaceful haven shared with comrades who have overcome hardships together, and that you can enjoy it along with the lingering emotions of the story.[/p][p][/p][p]Ending Theme Composer[/p][p]NILFRUITS[/p][p]―――――――――――[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?[/p][p]School RPG “VARLET”[/p][p][/p][p]A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: VARLET Derivative Works Guidelines
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"][/img]FURYU Corporation (hereinafter "The Company," "We," or "Us") has established the following guidelines for derivative works (the “Guidelines”) to ensure that " VARLET" (the “Product”) is enjoyable and accessible to a broad audience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Please observe the following guidelines when creating derivative works.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]１　Definitions[/b][/p][p](1)　“Individual” refers to persons who are not employed by or under contract with entertainment or talent agencies, or content creation companies that specialize in distributing content such as video or still images.[/p][p](2)　“Legal Entity” refers to businesses, and sole proprietors employed by or contracted with entertainment or talent agencies, or content creation companies that specialize in distributing content such as video or still images.[/p][p](3)　“Customer” refers to anyone enjoying the Product, including those identified above.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]２　Scope of Derivative Works[/b][/p][p](1)　Creation, display, and distribution of Illustrations, manga, stories, etc. (including digital works).[/p][p](2)　Creation, display, and distribution of character cosplays.[/p][p](3)　Character cosplay, photography and filming of cosplay, and the display and distribution of cosplay photos or videos.[/p][p](4)　Creation, display, and distribution of physical items, such as merchandise, accessories, and figures.[/p][p](5)　Streaming, posting, and sharing videos or still images that make use of video or still images captured during regular gameplay.[/p][p]* When engaging in any of the above activities, please indicate clearly in your work that it is a derivative creation.[/p][p]* For "streaming, posting, and sharing videos or still images" as described in item (5), please also ensure you review and understand Section 5, "Regarding Video Streaming and Posting of Images."[/p][p] [/p][p][b]３　Eligibility to Engage in Derivative Works[/b][/p][p]These Guidelines apply exclusively to derivative works created for personal, non-commercial presentation and distribution.[/p][p]If a Legal Entity wishes to create derivative works or an individual wishes to engage in derivative works that are presumed to exceed the criteria set forth in These Guidelines, please inquire with us directly in advance [url="https://www.furyu.jp/english/contact.html"]via this link[/url].[/p][p]Additionally, Legal Entities may also freely create, publish, and distribute content showcasing The Product that features videos or images captured during normal gameplay, provided this content does not violate the prohibited items set forth in Section 6. 

[/p][p][b]４　Scope of Non-Commercial Purposes[/b][/p][p]Derivative works are considered non-commercial if they are created by The Customer without a profit motive. Use within the scope of a hobby with compensation or profit only to cover the extent of supply, utility, and similar expenses, falls within the scope of non-commercial purposes. Income from advertising systems on video-sharing sites such as YouTube, etc. is also considered non-commercial.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]５　Regarding Video Streaming and Posting of Images[/b][/p][p](1) To ensure that this work can be enjoyed by as many customers as possible, the following areas are designated as restricted for streaming and posting. Please refrain from uploading or streaming gameplay videos or screenshots from the sections listed below.
[b]・Restricted areas for streaming/posting: From Chapter 8 onward[/b][/p][p](2)　Please respect the experience of other Customers enjoying the Product when streaming video or posting still images.[/p][p](3)　If a Customer's stream or post content contains spoilers, such as major plot points, please clearly label it with a "Contains Spoilers" indication to be considerate to those who have not played the game yet. Do not include spoilers in titles and thumbnails of videos that are streamed or posted, as they may be unintentionally seen by future players.[/p][p](4) 　When streaming videos or posting screenshots, customers are required to include the following copyright notice:[/p][p]© FURYU Corporation.[/p][p](5)　If a video stream or post, or still image post is found to contain content deemed to fall under the Prohibited Items set forth by the Company in Section 6, we may pursue legal action, including removal, etc. of the content. We do not individually contribute to, license, or promote videos posted by Customers as official content.

[/p][p][b]６　Prohibited Items[/b][/p][p]Customers, regardless of status as Individuals, are prohibited from posting content that corresponds or may correspond to the following:[/p][p](1)　Conflicts with public order and morality.[/p][p](2)　Violates the right of a third party.[/p][p](3)　Promotes specific products, services, political activities, religious activities, etc.[/p][p](4)　Violates laws and regulations such as criminal acts and antisocial activities, or includes expressions or aims to affirm or encourage such activities.[/p][p](5)　Can be deemed as non-transformational, such as content that includes scans or tracings, or unaltered use of content from the Product (such as logos, illustrations, videos, sound assets, music, comics, etc.).[/p][p](6)　Falsely represents sponsorship, authorization, or affiliation with Us, or includes statements that could imply such a relationship.[/p][p](7)　Is otherwise deemed unsuitable by Us.[/p][p]If any content violates these prohibitions, We may take legal action at our discretion, including the suspension of publication of the creative work.[/p][p] [/p][p]Please note that We assume no liability for any loss arising from engaging in derivative works, even if done in accordance with these Guidelines.[/p][p] [/p][p]Any derivative work that infringes on the rights of others, including the Company’s rights, may result in direct consequences for The Customer involved. Please follow all applicable laws, rules, and common courtesy when engaging in derivative works.[/p]

notes.title: Insert Song MV Ema Noma (CV: Aoi Koga) “inheritance” Released!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you always for your continued support of [i]VARLET[/i].[/p][p]FURYU Corporation is pleased to announce the release of the MV for “inheritance” performed by popular voice actor Aoi Koga and composed by renowned composer Daibakuhasin![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/V6MGPw9VZ3I"][/dynamiclink]「inheritance」[/p][p]Song/ Ema Noma (CV: Aoi Koga)[/p][p]COMPOSER/Daibakuhasin[/p][p][/p][p]This song is also included in the “Digital Special Album,” a bonus item in the [i]VARLET[/i] Digital Deluxe Edition![/p][p]To celebrate the release of the MV for the main character theme song “inheritance” we also received a comment from composer Daibakuhasin![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/0acac900561708baba8c5dd85932846cf6f65641.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Full comment:[/b][/p][p]Hello, this is Daibakuhasin.[/p][p]I had the pleasure of composing an original song titled “Inheritance”.[/p][p][/p][p]There is a term, “desire for recognition.”[/p][p]It has become much more visible in our lives with the rise of social media, but I believe this desire has existed since ancient times and will never disappear from the human heart.[/p][p]The song I created this time reflects my own way of facing and engaging with that desire.[/p][p]Thank you for listening.[/p][p][/p][p][b]— Daibakuhasin, Composer of “inheritance”[/b][/p][p]――――――――――――
Is the world worth saving, even if it means losing yourself?
A juvenile RPG [i]VARLET[/i], set in a collapsing school.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with their identity confront the monsters of “approval-seeking” that lurk within their hearts.[/p][p][b]
Releasing on August 28, 2025 (JST)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Insert Song MV Taiga Tsukiyama(CV: Toshinari Fukamachi) “Wagamama” Now Streaming
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you always for your continued support of [i]VARLET[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]FURYU Corporation is pleased to announce the release of the MV for “Wagamama,” performed by popular voice actor Toshinari Fukamachi and composed by renowned composer KANON69![/p][previewyoutube="NcBZqY13xI0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]「Wagamama」 [/p][p]Song/Taiga Tsukiyama (CV: Toshinari Fukamachi)[/p][p]COMPOSER/KANON69![/p][p][/p][p]This song is also included in the “Digital Special Album,” a bonus item in the [i]VARLET[/i] Digital Deluxe Edition![/p][p]To celebrate the release of the MV for the main character theme song “Wagamama,” we also received a comment from composer KANON69![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f82b314965a5a079743c5a3c3369fd9b0f6e9b70.png"][/img][b]Full comment:[/b][/p][p]This song portrays the ideal self of Taiga Tsukiyama—a genius who walks his own path.[/p][p]Everyone wants to play the role of their ideal self, but eventually, cracks begin to show.[/p][p]The “ore” that is repeated throughout this song might be, in a way, a cruelly opposite figure to Taiga Tsukiyama himself.[/p][p]In truth, he may not have any talent at all.
To come face-to-face with that “true self” = “Wagamama.”[/p][p]I hope you’ll overcome this hardship, which many creators face, together with him.[/p][p][b]— KANON69, Composer of “Wagamama”[/b][/p][p]――――――――――――
Is the world worth saving, even if it means losing yourself?[/p][p]
A juvenile RPG [i]VARLET[/i], set in a collapsing school.[/p][p][/p][p]Boys and girls struggling with their identity confront the monsters of “approval-seeking” that lurk within their hearts.[/p][p][b]
Releasing on August 28, 2025 (JST)[/b][/p]

notes.title: "VARLET" game controls update
notes.notes:
Regarding our developing project "VARLET," we have received feedback about conforming the keyboard and mouse controls. Here, we would like to officially announce that the keyboard and mouse controls will be available.

In order to enhance the gaming experience for various players, we are currently adjusting the programs before the release.

Thank you for your support of "VARLET."
